name: Enhance Ability
summary: Gives a creature Advantage on ability checks with one ability you choose.

stats.effect: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has {ref:glossary/advantage} on ability checks using the chosen ability.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.
